# cpanel_domains (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel web-domain inventory from `DomainInfo::list_domains`, normalized and sorted by domain name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The account domains sorted by normalized name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The normalized domain name.
- `type` (String) The cPanel domain category: `main`, `addon`, `subdomain`, or `alias`.
